description.p: NeoNect is a next-generation desktop messenger built with Qt 6 and QML, featuring hardware-accelerated UI rendering, pervasive lazy loading, and uncompromising End-to-End Encryption (AES-256-GCM and Curve25519).

ul.li: End-to-End Encryption for all direct messages, attachments, and media transfers.
Hardware-accelerated media lightbox for audio, video, and ultra-high-resolution images.
Low-latency real-time presence indicators and customizable status switcher.
Pervasive lazy loading architecture delivering up to 40% memory reduction.

description.p: Production release with complete end-to-end encrypted media transfers, pervasive lazy loading, and full-screen video/audio lightbox capabilities.
